sourceAnchors.visualArbitrationNote: Printed page 473 explicitly limits the extreme form of Isolierung: complete isolation in all vector domains is rare; more often complete isolation is found in only two vectors while the others show Tritendenz that still contains an isolation tendency.

Fall 40 shows a stereotyped vertical splitting of opposite pairs across all four vector domains. Szondi calls this especially characteristic in the worked case and then states more generally that predominance of ambivalence in Zwangsneurosen becomes experimentally visible as a consequence of vertical splitting of the drive opposites.

sourceExcerpt: Besonders charakteristisch ist aber die stereotype vertikale Spaltung der Gegensatzpaare in allen vier Vektorgebieten.
romanianRendering: Fall 40 prezintă o stereotypische vertikale Spaltung a perechilor de contrarii în toate cele patru domenii vectoriale. Totuși, pagina 473 precizează că forma extremă de Isolierung în toate domeniile este rară și că, mai frecvent, două vector-e arată izolare completă, iar celelalte păstrează Tritendenz cu tendință de izolare.
doctrinalStatement: Exemplul Fall 40 arată forma puternică, în toate cele patru vector-e, a `vertikale Spaltung`; Szondi o folosește pentru a ilustra predominanța Ambivalenz. Dar acest exemplu nu poate fi transformat într-o condiție necesară: regula generală de la p. 473 spune că formele extreme de Isolierung sunt rare și că structura apare mai frecvent complet în numai două vector-e, cu Tritendenz în celelalte. Prin urmare, `all-four-vector` este o formă exemplară/puternică, nu un prag obligatoriu.
conditions: Interpret vertical splitting at vector/series level and preserve the distinction between vollständige Isolierung and Tritendenz carrying Isolierungstendenz.
Use Fall 40 as an illustrative configuration under the general p. 473 rule.
exceptions: Do not require stereotyped vertical splitting in all four vector domains as a necessary condition.
Do not treat the rare extreme pattern as more general than the source's explicit p. 473 frequency limitation.
Do not infer a contemporary diagnosis from vertical splitting alone.
scopeNotes: This record is deliberately a reconciliation/limit record so that the memorable Fall 40 example does not overwrite the broader source rule.
The exact per-vector frequencies in Fall 40 remain case data rather than doctrine thresholds.

relations.note: Uses Fall 40 to illustrate the strong all-four-vector form while preserving 000045's explicit statement that the extreme form is rare.

ambiguities: The phrase `besonders charakteristisch` occurs inside a worked case; the general page-473 frequency statement prevents promoting the all-four configuration to a necessary rule.
